articles.summary: Through their stories, families, advocates and experts paint a vivid picture of what life with Angelman syndrome looks like – the obstacles, the triumphs and the moments of strength that define their journeys. They share their experiences navigating the path to diagnosis, the hallmark signs and symptoms of AS and, most importantly, the incredible joy that their children with AS bring to their lives.
articles.title: Behind the Mystery of Angelman Syndrome: A Journey of Resilience and Strength
